description: GTWF Database of U.S. Geotechnical Faculty, 2022 (Geotechnical Women Faculty Project) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Shobha Bhatia, Syracuse University (syracuse.edu). In 2016 the GTWF project built a national database of geotechnical faculty: first by gathering names of geotechnical faculty whose articles appeared in The Journal of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Engineering, and later expanding to web searches of universities with geotechnical programs and manual review of Civil Engineering department websites. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-8avc-9s93. Keywords: geotechnical, faculty, database, gender parity. Published 2022-03-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
